Title: Vikram's Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 29 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 55 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Meenakshi - 31 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The bazaar - fruit stalls, a crowd

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Vikram stands in the ward. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "What lovely weather!"

[Vikram checks Mother's pulse.]

Vikram (excited): "Really?"

[Vikram lies down on the hospital bed.]

Vikram: "Mom, look at this."

[Vikram walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Sonali: "Vikram, look at this."

[Vikram coughs and holds his chest.]

Sonali: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The bazaar - Day

[Vikram stands in the bazaar. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Vikram, look over here."

[Vikram haggles with the shopkeeper.]

Vikram: "Listen!"

[Vikram pays the fruit seller.]

Vikram: "This is amazing!"

[Vikram walks through the crowded bazaar.]

Vikram: "That was such a fun day!"
